body:
This year, we’re celebrating the little things - and we don’t just mean babies and toddlers!

When it comes to choosing the right pieces for your nursery, the smallest details can make a big difference in how each piece functions, looks, and serves your needs. Often, these little design details decide whether a dresser or crib feels like luxury and stays in your family for generations of use, or winds up being frustrating to use and carted off to the landfill before its time.

So today, we’re celebrating four of our favorite furniture details that add that little bit of extra function, style, and safety to our dadada Baby collection. A little bit goes a long way, and each one of these details is specifically designed to make sure your nursery is the best it can be.

Fave Feature #1: Soft-Close Drawers

Our most popular dadada Baby dresser comes equipped with a special feature - soft-close drawers. These slow-to-shut parent helpers make sure you’ll never wake up a sleeping baby with a banging drawer, which means you’re free to organize the nursery while your little one naps. They also create an important safety feature for small fingers - slow close means no slams, and less chance of pinching!

You can find soft-close drawers on the dadada Baby Soho 5-Drawer Dresser in White + Natural or Black + Natural.

Fave Feature #2: 4-Way Airflow

Good quality airflow is an essential component of safe, healthy baby sleep. It’s why we recommend using only a well-fitting crib mattress and fitted sheet in your dadada Baby crib - no additional bumpers, pillows, stuffies, or blankets needed!

When used with these instructions, our Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Cribs provide 4-way airflow for sleeping little ones by allowing air to flow unobstructed through all four walls of the crib. You and your baby will both rest easy knowing they’ll be set up to breathe freely!

Check out the 4-way airflow on the Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib here.

Fave Feature #3: Solid Wood Crib Construction

The crib is likely to be baby’s most-used piece of furniture, and for that reason, 2024 is the perfect time to say goodbye to chipping veneer, eco-unfriendly plastics, and flimsy particle board when it comes to this essential staple! dadada Baby cribs are crafted from 100% natural, solid hardwoods that are ready to withstand all the bouncing, teething, late nights, and long naps in your baby’s future. We choose to build our cribs with solid wood because we want them to last - to become a cherished heirloom and a part of your family’s story. It’s also how we do our part to make sure we aren’t contributing more fast furniture to landfills, and using sustainable, regrowable materials in each of our modern crib designs.

Our solid wood cribs are available in natural finish to show off the beautiful wood grain, or painted with baby-safe paints in a variety of on-trend colors and classic neutrals.

Explore all the options.

Fave Feature #4: Solid Wood Mattress Base

The mattress base is kind of a big deal. It’s the support piece that will be holding your most precious tiny loved one while they dream! That’s why we only reach for the best, most trustworthy material for its construction - solid, natural wood.

Our Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib comes complete with an adjustable height mattress base made from solid beechwood. The adjustable height allows you to create the safest possible sleep scenario as baby grows (learn more about the different settings in this blog), and solid beechwood means you can trust it will be stable, sturdy, and reliable for years to come.

Find your favorite shade of Soho here.

Here’s to celebrating the little things in 2024! Whether it’s soft-close drawers that help protect good sleep and little fingers, solid wood construction that elevates both function and style, or 4-way airflow that helps everyone breathe easy, we’ll continue to innovate and build new details that take your nursery to the next level in beauty and comfort - because every parent knows what a big difference something little can make!

What are your favorite dadada Baby features? Let us know on IG by tagging @dadadababyusa
